The review is done. The PR is a one-line change, and three convention rules apply to it: one is a real behavior problem and two are process or coverage gaps. I didn't touch any tracked files; the rule checklist was generated in the scratchpad instead of `docs/engineering/`.

**Mode:** `--review-pr`, scoped to `f09ce2ceb...HEAD`. That range is one commit, `f5a911618 fix(web): Hide checkmark on indeterminate checkbox`, with one file changed (+1 / −1): `apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx`.

**Checklist:** I considered all 78 rules in `rules.json`. Three apply: **PROD-01**, **FEAT-04** and **TEST-02** (together with the web guideline that components get a Storybook story). None of the others match this diff. That includes CODE-02, since the long class string was already there, and UI-01, since no colours or assets were added. I used the Level 1 lookup for FEAT-04 (RL-20260310-009). I didn't need the Level 2 GitHub lookup.

## Findings

### 1. PROD-01: the indeterminate state now looks exactly like unchecked
**`apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx:42`** (styling for the box itself is at `:35`)
- **What:** The fix adds `data-indeterminate:[&>svg]:hidden`, which hides the only icon the indicator has (`CheckIcon`). The filled background (`data-checked:bg-primary`, `data-checked:border-primary`) only applies when the box is checked. So a box with `checked={false} indeterminate` now shows as an empty grey-bordered square, which is how an unchecked box looks.
- **Where users see it:** `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SelectAllToggle/SelectAllToggle.tsx:53`. The "Select all" toggle with only some items selected (`state === 'some'`) now looks the same as nothing selected. Screen readers still get `aria-checked="mixed"`, but sighted users lose the partial-selection cue.
- **Fix:** Show a dash (`MinusIcon`) for indeterminate instead of hiding the icon. Either render both icons and switch between them with `data-indeterminate`, or pass the icon based on state. Also add `data-indeterminate:bg-primary data-indeterminate:border-primary data-indeterminate:text-primary-foreground` so a partial selection looks as clearly set as a checked box. If an empty box really is what design wants, say so explicitly in the PR, as PROD-01 requires.

### 2. FEAT-04: an edit to a shared primitive doesn't mention design-system coordination
**`apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx:42`**
- **What:** The file is under `apps/web/src/components/ui/*`. FEAT-04 requires the PR to either coordinate with any open design-system rewrite of these primitives or state that none is open. RL-20260310-009 records edits being lost to merge conflicts when this was skipped.
- **Fix:** Check for open PRs touching `components/ui/checkbox.tsx` and add a line to the PR description (for example "No open design-system PR touches checkbox.tsx"), or rebase onto that branch if one exists. I didn't check open PRs because this review had to stay offline (no `gh`).

### 3. TEST-02 and the Storybook rule: the new indeterminate styling isn't covered anywhere
**`apps/web/src/components/ui/stories/checkbox.stories.tsx:39-51`**
- **What:** The change adds styling that only applies in the indeterminate state, but the checkbox stories only show unchecked, checked, disabled, and checked + disabled. There's no indeterminate story, so the story snapshot workflow can't catch a regression like finding 1. `apps/web/AGENTS.md:10` and `:147-148` expect visual states to be covered by stories, and the existing `SelectAllToggle` tests only check click handlers, not how the box looks.
- **Fix:** Add `<Checkbox indeterminate />` and `<Checkbox indeterminate disabled />` to the states story, so the snapshot fails if the look of a partial selection changes.

## Summary
| # | Rule | File:line | Kind |
|---|------|-----------|------|
| 1 | PROD-01 | `apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx:42` | Behavior: indeterminate looks like unchecked |
| 2 | FEAT-04 | `apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx:42` | Process: no design-system coordination note |
| 3 | TEST-02 / Storybook | `apps/web/src/components/ui/stories/checkbox.stories.tsx:39-51` | Coverage: no indeterminate story |

No questions left open beyond the design-intent call in finding 1. No convention docs changed and no rule-mapping gaps were found.
